reason: A proposes a physically established, composition-preserving competition between dislocation storage and thermally activated cross-slip/recovery, with explicit temperature–strain-rate conditions, a baseline, microstructural measurements, and a clear falsification test. B relies on an unsupported universal “critical” stacking-fault density and possible FCC transformation extrapolated mainly from Co-containing CrMnFeCoNi, while its proposed in situ SEM/TEM testing is poorly matched to truly dynamic strain rates.
